target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.setup: At a fixed target null mu0, let E1_t and E2_t be the two valid channel e-processes. The deployed nine-split grid has alpha_i=i*delta/10 and beta_i=(10-i)*delta/10 for i=1,...,9, delta=.05. The minimax selector minimizes max(log(1/(alpha_i E1_t)), log(1/(beta_i E2_t))), equivalently maximizes min(i E1_t,(10-i)E2_t).
target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.selection_region: If split i is selected, with r=E1_t/E2_t, then (9-i)/i <= r <= (10-i)/(i-1), using 0 and infinity at the boundaries.
target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.miscoverage_implication: If either selected component crosses its selected threshold, then E1_t+E2_t >= 90/(delta*i*(10-i)) >= 3.6/delta. For delta=.05 this is E1_t+E2_t>=72.
target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.anytime_bound: Because (E1_t+E2_t)/2 is itself an e-process under the joint target null, Ville implies P(there exists t with selected-pair target-null miscoverage) <= 2/(3.6/delta)=5*delta/9. At delta=.05 this is 1/36 = 0.027777777777777776. Independence between channels is not required.
target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.interpretation: The exact deployed bottleneck/minimax selector is therefore same-history anytime-safe for the fixed target null, with a stronger sufficient bound than 5%, despite the earlier arbitrary-selector counterexample. This result is specific to target-null evidence used by the selector.
target_null_minimax_selector_theorem.off_target_boundary: It does not establish simultaneous numerical confidence coverage for an unknown true parameter theta != mu0, because E_j(mu0) need not be e-valid under theta and the selector can correlate with E_j(theta). The existing exact 0.087975 off-target e-value-family counterexample remains applicable to the absence of a general numeric-CI theorem.

sanity_stress.model: two independent fair-sign e-processes with factors 1.5 and 0.5; exact minimax grid selector recomputed each time
sanity_stress.role: sanity check only; theorem does not depend on Monte Carlo

off_target_v3_fixed_pilot_stress.model: 40-block Bernoulli(theta) scores, predictable alternating exposure weights .25 and 1.0, selector computed from target mu0=.05, selected same-history true-theta e-value thresholds checked at the pilot.
off_target_v3_fixed_pilot_stress.result: No inflation above 0.3% was observed in this conservative fixed-pilot family; this is negative stress evidence only and cannot override the exact off-target existence counterexample.
off_target_v3_fixed_pilot_stress.scope_guard: Small Monte Carlo and a single benign Bernoulli/predictable-weight family. Do not infer general same-history numeric coverage.
